verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events can ingest from streaming sources such as Kafka or Google Pub/Sub, and from an HTTP Tracking API usable from any application, so external feeds can reach the warehouse. Most other collection paths are SDKs for your own instrumented web, mobile and backend apps. Identity Resolution unifies data across multiple sources, but the evidence never shows native connectors for third-party cloud apps. missing for 10: native source connectors for third-party SaaS/cloud apps (e.g. CRM, billing, support tools), webhook or source ingestion from external vendors, documentation of supported third-party sources, independent corroboration.
